title: Funding Level Loading for Off-Cycle Wage Payouts — Paystride Instant Pay Disbursement Service
content:
**Clause.** A Paystride Instant Pay Disbursement Service that sent 2 or more off-cycle wage payouts in the month ending today, a month that takes in every payout dated fewer than one whole month before today, whole months between two dates being the difference in calendar months between them, less one when the later date's day of the month is smaller than the earlier date's, adds 10 percent to its funding level, one that sent a single off-cycle wage payout in that month adds 5 percent, and any other service adds nothing for off-cycle wages.

| Off-cycle wage payouts in the month ending today | Loading |
|---|---|
| 2 or more | 10 percent |
| exactly 1 | 5 percent |
| none | nothing |

The kind of pay of each payout is read from the service's ledger; tips, final pay, bonuses and expense reimbursements are not off-cycle wages. For a day that is the 20th of a month, an off-cycle wage payout dated the 21st of the previous month falls in the month ending today and one dated the 20th of the previous month does not.
